description: PRD-38.4: SDK Foundation (Backend Scope) - Backend Widget API endpoints, API key management, session token exchange, CORS, and rate limiting to power the embeddable SDK. npm packages require separate repo.

userStories.title: Create api_keys table via migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a database table for managing API keys that authenticate SDK widget requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Alembic migration for sdk_api_keys table: id UUID PK, workspace_id UUID FK workspaces, name VARCHAR(200), key_prefix VARCHAR(8), key_hash VARCHAR(64)
Add permissions TEXT[] for permission list
Add index on key_hash, index on workspace_id
userStories.notes: Created 20260225_create_sdk_api_keys.py with all columns, CHECK constraint on key_type, unique index on key_hash, index on workspace_id. Chains from 20260225_ws_shares.

userStories.title: Create ApiKey SQLAlchemy model
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an ORM model for the sdk_api_keys table.
userStories.notes: Created SdkApiKey model with all columns, workspace relationship via backref. Registered in __init__.py.

userStories.title: Create API key management service
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a service for creating, validating, and revoking API keys with SHA-256 hashing.
acceptanceCriteria: create_api_key() generates 32-byte hex key, stores SHA-256 hash, returns full key once
validate_api_key(key) looks up by hash, checks is_active and expires_at, updates last_used_at
list_api_keys(workspace_id) returns keys with masked prefix
check_domain(api_key, origin) validates against allowed_domains with wildcard support
check_permissions(api_key, permission) validates key has required permission
userStories.notes: Created ApiKeyService with all 6 static methods. Uses hashlib SHA-256, secrets.token_hex(32), fnmatch for wildcard domain matching.

userStories.title: Create API key management endpoints
userStories.description: As a workspace admin, I need REST endpoints to create, list, and revoke API keys.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/api-keys creates key, returns full key string once
GET /api/api-keys lists workspace keys (masked, prefix only)
Validates public keys require non-empty allowed_domains
userStories.notes: Replaced stub with full CRUD. Pydantic field_validator on permissions. Public key domain requirement enforced. Already registered in main.py.

userStories.title: Create widget auth middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I need auth middleware that validates API keys for Widget API requests.
acceptanceCriteria: widget_auth dependency extracts Bearer token from Authorization header
Returns 401 for invalid keys, 403 for domain mismatch
userStories.notes: Created widgets/ package with auth.py. JWT session token path first, raw API key fallback. WidgetAuthContext dataclass. require_permission() dependency factory.

userStories.title: Create session token exchange endpoint
userStories.description: As an SDK integrator, I need to exchange API keys for short-lived session tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Request: {api_key, user_id (optional), permissions (optional subset), expires_in (default 3600, max 86400)}
Generates signed JWT with workspace_id, api_key_id, permissions, expires_at
userStories.notes: Created session.py with POST /auth. Server-type keys only. Permission subsetting validated. expires_in clamped to [60, 86400]. 500 if WIDGET_TOKEN_SECRET not configured.

userStories.title: Create Widget Chat API endpoint
userStories.description: As an SDK user, I need a chat endpoint with streaming responses.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns SSE stream: message, tool-start, tool-end, tool-data, done events
Scoped to workspace from API key
userStories.notes: Created chat.py reusing ChatService/StreamingChatService from consumers.chatbot. SSE streaming with workspace isolation. History endpoint queries messages table. 503 fallback if chat consumer unavailable.

userStories.title: Create Widget Documents API endpoint
userStories.description: As an SDK user, I need endpoints to search knowledge base and get documents.
userStories.notes: Created documents.py with ILIKE search and full document retrieval. Workspace-scoped. Snippet truncation to 200 chars.

userStories.title: Create Widget Data Query API endpoint
userStories.description: As an SDK user, I need endpoints for NL queries and SQL execution.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/widgets/data/query accepts {question}, runs NL2SQL, returns {sql, columns, rows, summary}
userStories.notes: Created data.py with NL2SQL query (503 if service unavailable) and read-only SQL execute. Validates against 12 mutation keywords via regex. Returns structured columns/rows.

userStories.title: Create CORS middleware for Widget API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need dynamic CORS that validates origins per API key.
acceptanceCriteria: On OPTIONS: extract API key, validate origin against allowed_domains
Set Allow-Origin to matching origin, Allow-Headers, Allow-Methods, Max-Age 86400
Return 403 if origin does not match
userStories.notes: Created WidgetCORSMiddleware extending BaseHTTPMiddleware. Scoped to /api/widgets. Permissive preflight, CORS headers on actual requests. Registered in main.py.

userStories.title: Create rate limiting for Widget API
userStories.description: As a developer, I need per-key rate limiting to prevent abuse.
acceptanceCriteria: Track request counts per API key (in-memory or Redis)
Public defaults: 30 req/min; Server defaults: 1000 req/min
userStories.notes: Created RateLimitStore (thread-safe sliding window) and WidgetRateLimitMiddleware. Per-key override via request.state.rate_limit. 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers. Registered in main.py.

userStories.title: Mount Widget API router with middleware
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all widget endpoints under /api/widgets with CORS and rate limiting.
acceptanceCriteria: Apply CORS and rate limiting middleware to widget router
userStories.notes: Created router.py mounting 4 sub-routers with try/except. Health endpoint at /api/widgets/health. Registered widget_api_router, WidgetCORSMiddleware, WidgetRateLimitMiddleware in main.py.

userStories.title: Add API key management UI to settings
userStories.description: As a workspace admin, I want to manage API keys from the settings page.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists keys: name, prefix (masked), type badge, permissions, created, last used, status
Create Key dialog: name, type, permission checkboxes, allowed domains, rate limits, expiry
Shows full key ONCE after creation with copy button and warning
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created 875-line ApiKeyManager.tsx with key list table, create dialog (9 permission checkboxes, domain textarea, rate limit, expiry), key-shown-once dialog with copy, and revoke confirmation. Uses useWorkspace hook and glass-card styling.
